decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical EXEC parameter and EXE header definitions.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
DOS MSPROC, EXEPATCH and BIOS SYSINIT1 include exe.inc.
The previous 1741-byte MSPROC comparison found two address bytes and one minor-version byte differing, with all other aligned bytes matching (review 092).
The previous 1643-byte EXEPATCH comparison found 37 differing bytes, all in marked relocations (review 064).
limitations: Selected module comparisons support definitions exercised in those modules but not every declared field. Final version definition, link addresses and full core binary equality remain unverified.
